source_holds.description: Original Figure13.5.2.3-1 contact-geometry/pixel view not available via Library page-image retrieval; 25-7/N-keying source text read only.
Original six-page Table13.5.2.3-1 is text-audited by pin designator/signal groups, but dense modality-by-pin tick geometry cannot be independently pixel verified.
Text extraction split certain labels across PDF lines (e.g., MASTER_ARM and SENMAN), normalized only where plain source text supports reconstruction; exact original graphic remains held.
Ten SENMAN pins plus SENMAN_1–10 group appear in source but individual positional pairing cannot be independently confirmed from parsed text.
Eight reserved-for-arming-isolation pin numbers are recorded as a group; do not invent independent signal names or assigned roles.
MIL-STD1553B twinax source uses subcontact codes 25-1/25-2/25-S and 75-1/75-2/75-S, which are not interchangeable with ordinary numeric J2 pin IDs.
Uninspected original MIL-DTL-38999 and connector Figure/insert designs prevent independent physical connector conformance claim.
Original commercial IEEE Ethernet, MIL-STD1553B, USB and TIA422 companion standards not independently clause-audited by this packet.
The 28VDC logic-one threshold ≥18V and logic-zero threshold ≤1.5V do not define a universal state for intermediate input voltages.
Observation13.5.2.3-3 allows some program-specific higher voltage logic-zero handling for safety; this does not override current numbered Rules universally.
Power Enable ≥100kΩ OFF and ≤5Ω ON leave intermediate circuit-resistance behavior unspecified in these numbered Rules.
Platform/human-controlled open/closed circuit is a physical power-enable mechanism, not by itself a CSAPI Command, authorization, acknowledgement or independently witnessed effect.
J2 Power Enable max source 100mA and max drive 30VDC are electrical interface limits, not observed device output/available source power.
Table includes arming, cutout, mode-select, gimbal, memory purge and safety pins; none establishes real permissions, current applied armed state or live sensitive control effects.
J2 1 PPS pins are source-printed timing wires, not demonstrated synchronized clock accuracy, event time or observed source-case QA.
Safety status/annunciation pins are hardware signal design, not source-verified CSAPI Observation, status Datastream or sensor-health report.
J2 commercial-protocol pin names may vary slightly for signal integrity per Observation, not unrestricted permission to invent arbitrary mappings.
Original 2419 wire AWG24 silver-plated 19-strand definition is sourced to Observation13.5.2.3-4, not a universal wiring certification.
All further §13.5.2.3.2 Ethernet, §13.5.2.3.3 serial and additional arming/cutout sections remain outside this packet; labels in table do not certify their source rules.
Eight separate C239 DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI files, 2025 S251 Snapshot3 and restricted security overlay remain unreviewed.
No real Dragino/AirGradient/Campbell/Bennett source case proves installed J2 connector, source-case command or power transition.
Previous G2-7I and earlier SOSA source/figure holds remain unresolved; coverage of §13.5 parent remains partial.
